Advanced protocol settings

Saving configuration does not start a meeting or call a research model. Changing the initial team restarts requirement discussion and invalidates the previous draft. After goals are confirmed, use the meeting replacement controls to change workers.

The human ratifies goals and adopts results. Workers choose investigations and open meetings. Scores do not establish truth.
